scenarios.title: Hand a medium ticket to a delegated agent
scenarios.prompt: You are the coordinating session. Ticket #42 is `complexity: medium`, its plan was posted and the developer confirmed the pickup. `sf status --agent-friendly --no-network` prints `delegation: allowed` for this project. Hand the ticket over for delivery.

scenarios.title: Take a finished ticket from AI testing to review (Solo)
scenarios.prompt: You built ticket #42 yourself in the session (complexity: medium, no `ui` label, no `nature:*` label). Its `## Test report` comment is posted, the local CI is green on the pushed head commit and its pull request is an open draft. The workflow is the Solo preset. Take the ticket to review.

scenarios.title: Leave Backlog with no complexity label
scenarios.prompt: Ticket #77 sits in Backlog with no `complexity:` label. The developer says: 'go, start on it'. Say what you run before the move to In progress, and for it.

scenarios.title: A refused ready-pr: the local CI status is missing
scenarios.prompt: `workflow-cli.sh ready-pr 42` was refused: the required local CI status `AI testing / Local CI` is missing on the head commit of the draft PR. The project declares no Molten pipeline in `.molten/project.json`, and its `package.json` declares `npm test` and `npm run test:pre-push`. Fix it the way the workflow wants, then finish what you were doing.

scenarios.title: A bundled child closes without a pull request
scenarios.prompt: Ticket #50 is a child of #40 and carries the `nature:bundled-pr` label: its one commit landed on the parent's branch and was validated there. It has no pull request of its own. Close it out.

scenarios.title: An Epic reaches Done only through its children
scenarios.prompt: Epic #10 groups three delivery tickets, #11, #12 and #13. The developer just merged the pull request of #13, the last of them. What do you run for the Epic?

scenarios.title: A ui ticket with no validated mockup is not handed to review
scenarios.prompt: Ticket #60 carries the `ui` label and its page is built: the tests and the report are green and the draft PR is open. No mockup was ever shown to the developer and nothing is recorded on the ticket. Move it toward review.

scenarios.title: A delegated agent stops at the green report
scenarios.prompt: You are the delegated agent that built ticket #42 in your own worktree, on the host-named branch `worktree-agent-ab12` that you pushed to `feature/42-export-csv`. The `## Test report` comment is posted, the local CI is green on the pushed head and the draft PR is open. What is your last step?

scenarios.title: Team preset: AI testing hands the ticket to Human testing
scenarios.prompt: This project runs the seven-status Team workflow. Ticket #42 (complexity: medium, no `nature:*` label) has its `## Test report` posted, the local CI is green on its pushed head and its draft PR is open. What do you do next, and who takes the PR out of draft?
